doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR40: All game text, UI elements, and content are displayed in Ukrainian language. FR41: Key game terms remain in Ukrainian («Вечір при блекауті», «Світлячки», «Затишок»). FR42: The game maintains a light, cozy, humorous tone throughout all content.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Event Types: Low phone battery (plug into power bank), Boiling kettle (turn off), Candle needed or going out (light it), Cat stressed (calm it). Each event type has specific interaction requirements and descriptions.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Win Condition: Evening timer reaches 0 while «Затишок» > 0. Player earns XP and «Світлячки» based on performance. Lose Condition: «Затишок» hits 0 before the timer ends → evening ends early. Player still earns partial rewards if they made progress.

constraints.constraint: Translation Constants Structure: Create `src/utils/translations.ts` file for centralized Ukrainian text. Use TypeScript const objects or enums for type safety. Export named constants for each text string. Follow naming convention: `TRANSLATIONS` object with nested properties. Reference architecture document utils structure [Source: docs/architecture.md#Project-Structure].

Component Integration: Components import translations from `src/utils/translations.ts`. Replace hardcoded strings with translation constants. Maintain existing component structure (no major refactoring). Timer and CozinessBar already have Ukrainian text - verify consistency and move to translations.ts.

Event System Integration: EventIndicator component needs Ukrainian tooltips and accessibility text. Event type descriptions should match PRD specifications [Source: docs/prd.md#Event-Types-&-Scoring]. Event interaction hints should guide players in Ukrainian. Event type names: phone → "Телефон", kettle → "Чайник", cat → "Кіт", candle → "Свічка".

Ukrainian Language Requirements: All text must use proper Ukrainian grammar and spelling. Maintain light, cozy, humorous tone (PRD FR42) [Source: docs/prd.md#Localization-&-Content]. Key terms remain in Ukrainian: «Затишок», «Світлячки», «Вечір при блекауті». Reference PRD FR40, FR41, FR42 for localization specifications.

Text Integration Strategy: Incremental approach - Add Ukrainian text as features are built. Replace English placeholder text with Ukrainian translations. Ensure all gameplay UI elements use Ukrainian text. Prepare win/lose messages for future results screen (Story 4.3). Event descriptions should match PRD event types exactly.

Existing Ukrainian Text: Timer component already has "Час:" label (line 62 in Timer.tsx). CozinessBar component already has "Затишок" label (line 90 in CozinessBar.tsx). WelcomeScreen component already has Ukrainian text throughout. These should be moved to translations.ts for consistency, or at minimum verified to match translations.ts values.

Architecture Patterns: Follow naming conventions (PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions). Match file name to component name. Import organization: React imports, third-party imports, internal imports, type imports, CSS imports (at end). Use CSS Modules for styling (ADR-005).

Performance: No performance impact expected - text constants are static values. Translations file should be tree-shakeable (named exports). Components should import only needed translations to minimize bundle size.
